params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P1
Summary: The support bell's Send button does nothing for French-speaking users, so a garage that works in French cannot reach support through the platform at all.

A garage reported that typing a message in the bell ("Signaler une erreur") and pressing Envoyer does nothing, for every user of that garage. The same bell works in Dutch accounts.

Cause: the Send button's `onclick` passes the confirmation text to `custom.sendAnomaly('...')` inside single quotes. Blade escapes the apostrophe as `'`, the browser decodes it back before the handler runs, and the French text ("l'objet d'un suivi") ends the JavaScript string. The handler is a syntax error, so no request is sent and nothing is stored. Dutch, English and German have no apostrophe in that text, which is why it works there. The reset-option-order button on the Settings options tab has the same fault in French.

Source: Portal mail:41.
params.title: Support bell: Send does nothing for French-speaking users
